contract: construct() -> at most 32 distinct integers in 0..10^6 including 0, with all positive differences distinct (a Sidon set) and every d in 1..30 occurring as a difference. Minimize the largest element.
notes: A Sidon set realizing all differences 1..30 is a truncated perfect difference set; its least possible diameter measures the growth cost at this scale.
